items.description: The list to prepare, as the agent's user gave it. Items may have any fields, e.g. {name, domain} or {name, company, role, email}.

item_kind.description: A word for the reader: company, person, meeting, ...

identity_keys.description: Fields that identify an item, most trusted first, e.g. [domain, name] or [email, name+company]. A key joined with + is composite: every part must be present.

exclude.description: Items to drop, matched on the same identity keys.

max_items.description: How many items to accept at most.

slot_count.description: The number of branches the agent runs; slots has exactly this many entries.

query_hint.description: What each branch's search should look for, e.g. 'fit against this ICP: ...'. Appended to the item's own fields and shortened to fit.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Optional and not needed for the work; never guessed.
